project.name: 9router-cli
project.description: Production-grade AI CLI for 9 Router — connect, discover models, and chat with any AI model locally

dependencyGraph.cli.ts -> commands/: orchestrates all top-level modules, registers commands from every subsystem
dependencyGraph.cli.ts -> router/: uses NineRouterClient for API, ModelRegistry for model list
dependencyGraph.chat/engine.ts -> router/: uses RouterClient for API calls, streaming
dependencyGraph.router/ -> config/: depends on ConfigManager for base URL
dependencyGraph.session/ -> config/: depends on ConfigManager for storage path
dependencyGraph.commands/ -> all subsystems: can access chat, router, session, config, plugins, tui

dependencyRules: commands/ can access chat/, router/, session/, config/, plugins/, tui/
chat/engine.ts uses router/ for API, render/ for output, session/ for persistence
router/ depends only on config/ (base URL) and core/
render/ is standalone, depends only on core/ and utils/terminal.ts
plugins/ depends on core/, config/, provides API to commands/
